Republic of Angola
Visa regime
Citizens of Montenegro are required to obtain a visa in order to enter and stay in the Angolan territory. Reciprocally, the Angolan citizens must also acquire a visa prior to their sojourn in Montenegro. Issuance of visas is under the competence of the Embassy of Angola in Belgrade.
Contact: the Embassy of the Republic of Serbia in Luanda, the Republic of Angola Address: Comandante Nzagi 25/27, Alvalade, Luanda, Republic of AngolaPhone: (+244) 222321421(+244) 222327240(+244) 222320393Fax: (+244) 222321724Email: serbiaemb@netcabo.co.aoWebsite: http://www.luanda.mfa.gov.rs
Diplomatic Relations Overview
The Republic of Angola officially recognized Montenegro on the 21st of December 2009, and the diplomatic relations between the two countries were established on the same day.
Alcino dos Prazeres Izata Francisco da Conceição assumed the duty of the non-residential Ambassador to Montenegro on the 19th of July 2021.
Possibilities for further improvement of bilateral cooperation have been identified in the field of education, predominantly by the means of student exchange.
No bilateral treaties have been signed between Montenegro and the Republic of Angola, neither the mutual trade has, so far, reached any significant level.
